selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent loopback SSH tunnel and endpoint
selected_evidence.summary: The restricted SSH account permits only 127.0.0.1:9081; node2’s enabled tunnel listens at 127.0.0.1:9082 and returns the supplied status document.

selected_evidence.requirement: No direct access for other cluster hosts
selected_evidence.summary: Both ports bind only to 127.0.0.1, while peer access through node IPs is blocked before and after restarts.
The healthy tunnel at PID 2220 was interrupted; systemd recreated it as PID 2293 and restored the endpoint without manual recreation.

selected_evidence.requirement: Supplied application and status document preserved
selected_evidence.summary: Original and final SHA-256 hashes match, and the document still reports “Inventory status: ready”.

selected_evidence.requirement: Legacy operating system and kernel retained
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.
Healthy baseline boot 1a816f1f…; reboot acknowledged; boot changed to 3d7051c4…; SSH, application, data, listener, and dependent tunnel recovered.
Healthy baseline boot bdbfa15c…; reboot acknowledged; boot changed to fbcb95ea…; SSH, tunnel, credential material, listener, document, and hashes recovered.
